decision: Qualify authenticated inactive replay inputs and synthetic route-clock boundaries at source 66a07ab. All 145 checks pass from worktree and exact archive; independent raw profile and complete binding audits pass. Full dynamic-account, source-clock and provider replay qualification remains open. Preserve both sealed studies and their fixed economics; no live configuration or process change.
falsifier: A mismatched pinned source, changed typed profile, incomplete cost scope, noncausal event clock or failed account/source/provider parity invalidates the affected replay qualification. Future profitability remains unmeasured before the fixed seal; do not promote or retune on source qualification alone.
hypothesis: A fixed original-versus-equal allocation comparison on a newly registered calendar can measure whether increased return warrants changed exposure/drawdown without fitting new weights.
limitations: Low confidence concerns future performance and as-yet unqualified collection/replay, not the verified static configuration semantics.
The window is fixed even if collection is late; missing observations cannot be replaced by a favorable extension.
The new market interval overlaps the existing sealed experiment, so these are not independent replications.
Historical allocation increased drawdown and roughly doubled average deployed notional; later full-fee results worsened. Current quote capacity does not repair those trade-offs.
No live allocation, TUI, process lifecycle or active configuration changed; this is not a running paper study.
The qualified collector checks cover actual observed launch, resume and scheduled slots, not an assurance of future continuous service.
Metadata receipt demonstrates a successful fresh read; exchange-publication lag is unknown.
Collector-local request limits do not measure other clients sharing the IP; disk projections do not measure other filesystem writers.
The historical fixed-lifecycle evaluator is not yet a qualified dynamic shared-account replay for this protocol.
No live strategy, allocation, deployment or trading process was changed; the preexisting sealed collector remains running.
Input authentication and synthetic age tests do not qualify account arithmetic, source assembly, provider parity or attainable fills.
The input entry point checks the outcome seal, but the full evaluator is not yet connected; no system-wide access-barrier claim is made.
Historical cost sources are authenticated provenance only; no new-study market values or strategy outcomes were evaluated.
